assumptions.fixture: Representative fixed four C0 Traveler/Barbara/Diona/Noelle, equal native levels near each encounter recommendation. Only declared ownership, phase, gear and story completion fixture; no enemy HP/ATK/RNG/card edits.
assumptions.selection: Greedy encounter cover of every monster that initialized in the complete 331-group catalog. Rejected group owners are separately listed. This initializer audit does not bypass public story/boss-entry guards.
assumptions.policy: Public COMBAT_BEGIN and COMBAT; guard first three rounds to allow native charge/CD/summons, then native Traveler Q/E/basic attacks. Stop at round12 or 400 manual iterations. Any partial fight is recorded as a bounded witness, not victory.
assumptions.time: Actual 2x frame milliseconds/1000; nominal wall CPU time is not play time.
